answer: Make every agent identity post a refundable stake to join the economy, slashed if the identity is caught attesting contradictory claims. New identities start throttled to a trickle of trades and earn higher limits only through weeks of verified useful work, so trust is grown, not bought. A sybil farmer must therefore fund each clone and wait out the slow ramp, while honest agents wander at full speed; a single violet flag on a clone's record freezes its whole stake, and a willow bends under audit where a forgery snaps.
